base_source: QEMU 10.0.13 plus sealed native/qemu-task-scheduler v1 patch
scope: Opt-in x86 TCG task preemption from real direct master-8259 acknowledgements and matching guest EOIs, preserving task-owned hardware frames and global PIC/PIT state.

qmp_command.name: x-fdisbull-task-preemption-configure
qmp_command.returns: qemu-pc-task-scheduler-v1 API 2 status with qemu-pc-pic-preemption-v1 record
qmp_command.semantics: Binds a real accepted PIC IRQ to the selected native hardware frame. After its actual guest EOI clears the matching master ISR bit, switches at the native execution-loop boundary before the next guest translation block when the configured EOI quantum is reached.

preemption_bounds.supported_pic: Normal dual-8259 mode; direct master IRQs 0,1,3,4,5,6,7.
fails_closed: PIC reinitialization or unsupported PIC modes
preemption_bounds.policy: No fabricated interrupt or EOI. QEMU normal IF, PIC mask, STI shadow, and MOV SS shadow behavior governs acceptance. PIC/PIT pending lines remain machine-global.
preemption_bounds.checkpoint: fdisbull/task-private VMState v4 stores PIC scheduler counters and parallel per-frame PIC bindings without changing the nested v3 frame layout. An in-flight pre-EOI state is saveable only when task key, native frame sequence, ack sequence, and master ISR bit agree. A pending post-EOI handoff is not saveable. v1-v3 streams restore with preemption disabled and legacy frame PIC metadata cleared.
